discovery.pains_lead_part1: Recognize any of these? We designed the
discovery.p1_dor_desc: 30+ hours on listing portals. 80% is noise: misleading photos, off prices, sellers who don't reply. 90% give up before visiting.
discovery.p1_resp_desc: Top 3 already filtered — only what makes sense for your profile.
discovery.p2_dor_desc: The best of the market never shows up on any portal. Inheritance, divorce, relocation — access only for friends of brokers, doormen, building managers.
discovery.p2_resp_desc: Motivated owners step forward — including those whose property wasn't even for sale.
discovery.p3_dor_desc: Seller + experienced broker + 2-3 more brokers on one side. Buyer alone on the other. You pay the full price.
discovery.p3_resp_desc: Qualified candidates come to you. Negotiation works in your favor.
discovery.p4_dor_desc: From "I'm looking" to keys in hand: 60-120 days in capital cities. For anyone on a deadline (moving, divorce, pregnancy), it's unbearable.
discovery.p4_resp_desc: Median close in 30-60 days. You gain a month of life back.
discovery.p5_dor_desc: No advisor on the buyer's side: fear of irregular paperwork, hidden defects, inflated prices, problematic sellers. Result: paralysis.
discovery.p5_resp_desc: Guided visit. Mediated negotiation. Follow-through up to the deed.
discovery.radar_lead_part2: on social media. Paid media segmented by neighborhood + human curation identify motivated owners — including those who hadn't even thought of selling. That's the radar at work, live, across the entire state of Rio.
discovery.legend_ativo_desc: Active search — paid social campaign targeting the buyer's profile.
discovery.legend_off_desc: Owner activated by the campaign — property that wasn't even listed.
discovery.legend_match_desc: Candidate received or negotiation started with a qualified prospect.

social.title: Real people, finding what they were looking for.
